title: Rad Care Service Subscription
body_html:
Live near a RadRetail store? Rad Care is an annual subscription that covers tune-ups, flat tire repairs, and other in-store services to keep your ebike in peak condition. With free accessory installations and deep discounts on spare parts, it takes the guesswork out of ebike maintenance.

 

Important: Rad Care Service packages are only redeemable at participating RadRetail service locations. See available service locations here. 

Rad Care covers one ebike per subscription. If you've purchased multiple ebikes, you'll need to add a separate Rad Care plan for each ebike.
